title: AppliedVoltex
description: A standalone Applied Energistics 2 addon for late game autocrafting. Adds an instant ME assembler that runs patterns at full speed, plus two machines that automate Avaritia 9x9 Extreme Crafting through your network.
body:
Applied Voltex is a small addon for Applied Energistics 2. It adds three machines focused on autocrafting.

Instant Assembler. A crafting machine for your ME network that runs patterns very fast instead of one item at a time. It handles both crafting and processing patterns, and throughput scales with co-processors, so large orders finish quickly. Does not require Re:Avaritia.

Avaritia Assembler. Lets you autocraft Avaritia 9x9 (Extreme Crafting) recipes straight through your ME system. Requires Re:Avaritia.

Avaritia Encoder. Encodes Avaritia 9x9 recipes into AE2 patterns so the Avaritia Assembler can build them. Has a searchable recipe list. Requires Re:Avaritia.

Requires Applied Energistics 2. Re:Avaritia is optional and only needed for the two Avaritia machines. Despite the name, this mod does not require Voltex.
